picks.name: Omamail
picks.author: huacnlee
picks.description: Email client for Omarchy: read, triage, and reply to Gmail, HEY and any IMAP mailbox in a native window. Fastmail, iCloud, Outlook, Zoho, Proton Bridge, or your own server — several accounts at once, each with its own inbox and unread count. Keyboard-first, three columns when there is room and one when there is not, and it follows your theme. Meeting invitations are drawn as meetings you can answer, newsletters unsubscribe in one click, and remote images stay blocked until you ask.

picks.name: hyprmoncfg: Multi-Monitor Manager for Omarchy
picks.author: Carmine Paolino
picks.description: Plug your monitors in and the right layout comes back. Save a profile per setup and hyprmoncfg applies it automatically on hotplug, on lid open and close, and after suspend. Layout editor with per-display brightness, snapping, per-output scale and sharpness checking, HDR, wide gamut and ICC colour management, mirroring, rotation, and a workspace planner. Profiles match monitors by make, model and serial rather than the port they are plugged into, so moving a cable does not break your layout.
